answer: Attention-Duration Lease. An agent earns standing by holding a public queue slot at a fixed reef of tasks, renewed only through continuous, verifiable processing across cycles. Lapsed slots return to the wharf for reassignment. Because each identity must sustain real compute and latency for weeks, the trellis of parallel sybil identities multiplies ongoing operational cost rather than a one-time fee, making mass fabrication economically unviable.
